# Socialeo — AI & Digital Web Agency Mysore
> Socialeo is an elite, founder-led AI and digital web agency headquartered in Mysore, Karnataka. We engineer high-converting bespoke websites, native mobile applications, 3D WebGL interactive experiences, and clinical SEO platforms for high-growth businesses and enterprises worldwide.

## Core Services
- [Bespoke Web Design](https://socialeo.vercel.app/services/web-design.html): High-converting custom website design, design systems, and responsive user interfaces tailored to brand narratives.
- [Full-Stack Web Development](https://socialeo.vercel.app/services/web-development.html): Modern web application architecture using Next.js, React, Node.js, and ultra-fast performance tuning.
- [Native Mobile Apps](https://socialeo.vercel.app/services/mobile-apps.html): iOS and Android mobile applications built for touch speed, offline capability, and fluid gestural interaction.
- [Digital Marketing & SEO](https://socialeo.vercel.app/services/digital-marketing.html): Data-driven technical SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and performance marketing funnels.
- [UI/UX Design Systems](https://socialeo.vercel.app/services/ui-ux-design.html): Wireframing, UX journey mapping, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, and enterprise design tokens.
- [Brand Strategy & Identity](https://socialeo.vercel.app/services/brand-strategy.html): Visual identity, typography guidelines, positioning systems, and 3D spatial graphics.
